_comment: Acknowledged price-feed gaps. build.js resolves a held ticker missing a session three ways before this file matters: it re-fetches direct from Yahoo in case the payload was degraded, it reconstructs the session from intraday prints where they exist (bar tagged r:true, published in meta.recoveredBars), and it confirms a genuine non-trading day where the counter had no prints while its exchange was open. Only a gap that survives all three stops the bake, because at that point there is no honest number to publish and the name is withdrawn from the day cards. Record such a gap here, after establishing by hand what happened on the date, to clear the latch. An entry here is read by later sessions as verified fact, so a careless one is worse than the stop it clears. Entries are kept once inert, as a record of how often and how badly the feed fails.

acknowledged.note: Yahoo daily series returned a null bar for a real SGX session and a fabricated flat bar on the 10 Aug National Day holiday. Gap persists across every range and both query hosts. This was the incident that prompted the audit: it misplaced S$4,169 between the Intraday and 1-Day cards and showed ES3 as the day's largest contributor when it was down 0.24% on the session.

acknowledged.status: unresolved — withdrawn from the Intraday and 1-Day windows
acknowledged.verified: The exchange traded: 0700.HK printed 27,742,475 shares on the date and 9988.HK 73,086,522, both carrying full bars. The fund was alive and valued: Premia Partners struck a NAV of HKD 10.4607 for 2026-08-28, read from the issuer fund page on 2026-08-31, with no suspension, termination or delisting notice published. Yahoo returns a null daily bar on both query1 and query2, and its intraday series for the symbol stops mid-session on 2026-08-27 at about 14:44 Hong Kong time — 64 five-minute bars against a normal 80 — so the date is outside the print series and no reconstruction is possible.
acknowledged.note: The same Yahoo dropped-session defect as the 2026-08-11 incident, and it hit at least two Hong Kong names on this date: 3010.HK lost the same session and was rebuilt from prints, while 3173.HK could not be, because its print series does not reach the date. Whether the counter itself traded on 2026-08-28 cannot be established from the available feed, so the position is withdrawn from the day windows rather than assumed flat. The issuer NAV is evidence of liveness only and is deliberately not used as a close — it is a fund valuation struck once daily, not a market print, and substituting it would put a non-market number on the day boundary.

acknowledged.status: genuine non-trading day for the counter — not a feed defect
acknowledged.verified: The exchange traded: D05.SI printed 6,652,800 shares on the date and ES3.SI 715,891. The 5m series spans 2026-08-31 and carries six bars, none with any volume; the counter's last print of any size was 20 shares on 2026-08-26, five sessions earlier. The missing daily bar is therefore correct and the flat reading is right.
acknowledged.note: The same standing condition as this ticker's 2026-08-11 entry — D07 is thin enough to go several sessions without a print. The automatic untraded classifier settled it in August but not here, most likely because the intraday series carries only six bars for the date, so the case is recorded by hand instead.

acknowledged.note: Distinct from this ticker's 2026-08-28 entry, which was a real feed defect: there the intraday series stopped mid-session on 2026-08-27 and never reached the date, so nothing could settle it. Here the series covers the full session and shows the counter simply did not trade. The 2026-08-28 bar has since been backfilled by Yahoo and that entry is now inert.
